lead: This file is a fictional example. It shows what the skill produces: the state of a site on 2 November 2026 from five angles (Google, visitors, server, text, AI), each finding with its proof, and three to-do lists
headline: A clear, safe site that neither Google nor AI assistants know how to present

d-faits: Two customer figures, and Google shows both
d-pages: 41 pages without a description, 9 duplicate titles
d-blog: 31 articles, the latest from March 2024, none dated for Google
d-infra: Fast server (310 ms), but the text of the product pages arrives through JavaScript
d-securite: Encryption rated A, headers rated D, no trackers before consent
d-google: No structured data, a fake 404, two addresses for the same site
d-conversion: Short, clear form, no intermediate offer
d-ia: Cited in 0 of 16 market answers; well described on the brand question, with a wrong year

good: The offer is clear in 5 seconds
bad: The text of the product pages arrives through JavaScript
decisions: Hand 5 tasks to the front-end team and 7 to the back-end team
conditions: Monday 2 November 2026, tools from 10 am to 11 am, AI at 11 am and 3 pm
limites: Fictional example: the figures and screenshots are invented to show the format. In a real audit, without Search Console or audience measurement, clicks and positions are unknown

C1.name: One customer figure
C1.what: choose the right number of customer tradespeople with the product manager and use it on the home page and on “About”
C1.check: Verified when the “site:” search shows only one figure

C2.name: Complete “About” page
C2.what: add the legal name, the year founded, the address and the team
C2.check: Verified when all 4 items are online

C3.name: Unique titles
C3.what: write a title specific to each of the 9 pages called “Atelier Lumen” (the topic first, the brand last)
C3.check: Verified when the scan finds no duplicate

after.title: Quotes on your phone for tradespeople · Atelier Lumen

C3.where: `metadata` in the layout and the pages

C4.name: Descriptions
C4.what: write a description of 140 to 160 characters for the 41 pages that have none
C4.check: Verified when the scan counts 0 pages without a description

C5.name: Image descriptions
C5.what: describe each useful image in the “alt text” field; leave alt empty for decorative images
C5.check: Verified when WAVE no longer reports an image without a description

C6.name: Blog sort-out
C6.what: keep 12 articles, merge 9, remove 10 outdated articles (redirects: B5)
C6.check: Verified when the blog has about 16 up-to-date articles

C7.name: FAQ for tradespeople
C7.what: answer on one page the 10 questions tradespeople ask before trying the software (price, data, accounting export...)
C7.check: Verified when the page is online and approved

C8.name: Buying guide
C8.what: publish “How to choose quoting software”, which also serves as an intermediate offer
C8.check: Verified when the guide is online with its form

C9.name: Wikidata entry
C9.what: create the company's entry with the official site, the year founded and the head office
C9.check: Verified when a Wikidata search finds it

F1.name: Text readable without JavaScript
F1.what: generate the “Features” pages on the server (the framework's static rendering) instead of loading the text in the browser
F1.check: Verified when the HTML received contains the text of the page

F2.name: Home page images
F2.what: switch the photos to WebP or AVIF with `srcset`, `fetchpriority="high"` on the main image, `loading="lazy"` on the others
F2.check: Verified when PageSpeed mobile is above 75 on 3 runs

F3.name: Structured data
F3.what: add Organization (with `sameAs`) across the whole site and SoftwareApplication on the product pages
F3.check: Verified when the rich results test detects them with no errors

F4.name: Sharing tags
F4.check: Verified when the share preview is complete

F5.name: Contrast and focus
F5.what: darken the 4 light grey texts, add a `:focus-visible` style
F5.check: Verified when WAVE no longer reports a contrast issue

B1.name: Search Console
B1.what: verify the domain in Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, and submit the sitemap there
B1.check: Verified when clicks and positions can be read

B2.name: Real 404
B2.what: return the 404 code on an unknown address

B3.name: One address
B3.check: Verified when the version without www redirects in one step

B4.name: Security headers
B4.what: add Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, and hide the nginx version
B4.check: Verified when Security Headers gives B or better
B4.where: The server block of the site
B4.how: Add the lines below, then run `nginx -t` and reload. Test the site before enforcing the policy.

B5.name: Blog redirects
B5.what: redirect each removed or merged article to the closest article with a 301
B5.check: Verified when no old address returns 404

B6.name: Image caching
B6.what: `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` on versioned static files
B6.check: Verified when PageSpeed no longer reports a cache lifetime that is too short

B7.name: llms.txt
B7.what: publish a `/llms.txt` that presents the company and points to the reference pages
